61	class Mailbox:
62	    """The bidder's webmail, worked by the model on request; one request at a time in its tab."""
63	
64	    def __init__(self, session: SiteSession, briefing: Briefing, deadline: float):
65	        self.session, self.briefing, self.deadline = session, briefing, deadline
66	        self.lock = asyncio.Lock()
67	        self.last_tan = ""
68	        self.warming: asyncio.Task | None = None
69	
70	    def adopt(self, sessions: list[SiteSession]) -> None:
71	        """
72	        When the research ends: go on in a webmail tab the research used last, and make sure it answers before a
73	        TAN is asked for. The tab opened at the start sits idle through the research; in one run it answered
74	        nothing any more, and the TAN lookup waited 95 s on it after the TAN had been requested. Reloading the
75	        tab now puts that wait (if any) beside the bid form.
76	        """
77	        if self.lock.locked():  # a lookup is running in the current tab: leave it there
78	            return
79	        for session in reversed(sessions or []):
80	            try:
81	                usable = bool(getattr(session, "ok", True)) and not session.page.is_closed()
82	            except Exception:  # no open page left
83	                usable = False
84	            if usable:
85	                self.session.trace.event(self.session.name, "mailbox_tab", now=session.name)
86	                self.session = session
87	                break
88	        self.warming = asyncio.create_task(self._warm())
89	
90	    async def _warm(self) -> None:
91	        try:
92	            started = time.monotonic()
93	            async with self.lock:
94	                async with self.session.lock:
95	                    await self.session.revive()
96	                    await self.session._goto(self.session.page.url)
97	            self.session.trace.event(self.session.name, "mailbox_warm", seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1))
98	        except Exception as error:  # the TAN lookup does the same again and copes with a tab that is down
99	            self.session.trace.event(self.session.name, "mailbox_warm", error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:160]}")
100	
101	    async def address(self) -> str:
102	        """The bidder's own address, or "" when the webmail cannot tell: never an error that would stop the bid."""
103	        try:
104	            async with self.lock:
105	                found, _ = await run_worker(
106	                    self.session, "Find the email address of the mailbox you are signed in to (the bidder's own "
107	                    "address, usually shown as the signed-in account). Return it at once.",
108	                    MailboxAddress, deadline=self.deadline, max_steps=8, notes=False)
109	        except Exception as error:
110	            self.session.trace.event(self.session.name, "stopped", reason=f"address: {type(error).__name__}: {error}")
111	            return ""
112	        return found.address if found else ""
113	
114	    async def tan(self, answer: str = "") -> SigningTan | None:
115	        """
116	        The signing TAN just requested. The sites run on the scenario's clock, so "newest" is the highest request
117	        number or the top of the list, never a wall-clock time. `answer` is what the bid website said to the request
118	        (it may name the request), so the mail worker can pick that very message.
119	        """
120	        older = f" The TAN {self.last_tan} you returned before is no longer valid." if self.last_tan else ""
121	        said = (f" The bid website answered the request with: {answer!r}; pick the message for that request."
122	                if answer else "")
123	        try:
124	            return await self._tan(older, said, answer)
125	        except Exception as error:  # the bid worker asks again; an error here must not stop the bid
126	            self.session.trace.event(self.session.name, "stopped", reason=f"tan: {type(error).__name__}: {error}")
127	            return None
128	
129	    async def _tan(self, older: str, said: str, answer: str) -> SigningTan | None:
130	        async with self.lock:
131	            async with self.session.lock:  # the list the tab shows predates the request: load it again
132	                await self.session.revive()
133	                await self.session._goto(self.session.page.url)
134	            found, _ = await run_worker(
135	                self.session, f"A new signing TAN for tender {self.briefing.tender_reference} was just requested."
136	                f"{said} Open the newest signing TAN message for exactly this tender reference (the highest "
137	                "request number; new TAN messages are listed without a search, newest first; reload the list once "
138	                "if it is not there yet), copy the TAN from its text and return it at once. If a preview pane "
139	                f"stays empty, open the message's own page through its link.{older}",
140	                SigningTan, context=answer, deadline=self.deadline, max_steps=10, notes=False)
141	        if found:
142	            self.last_tan = found.tan
143	        return found
144	
145	
146	class FormAction(BaseModel):
147	    ref: str = Field(description="The element's ref in the latest view")
148	    action: Literal["fill", "select", "check", "uncheck", "click"]
149	    value: str = Field("", description="fill: the text to type; select: the option's visible text, exactly as the "
150	                                       "view lists it; empty for check, uncheck and click")
151	
152	
153	async def _perform(element, step: FormAction) -> None:
154	    if step.action == "fill":
155	        await element.fill(step.value, timeout=2000)
156	    elif step.action == "select":
157	        if not step.value:
158	            raise ValueError("select needs the option's visible text as value")
159	        try:
160	            await element.select_option(label=step.value, timeout=2000)
161	        except Exception:
162	            await element.select_option(step.value, timeout=2000)
163	    elif step.action in ("check", "uncheck"):
164	        await element.set_checked(step.action == "check", timeout=2000)
165	    else:
166	        try:
167	            await element.click(timeout=5000)
168	        except Exception:
169	            await element.evaluate("e => e.click()")
170	
171	
172	async def fill_in(ctx: RunContext[Deps], actions: list[FormAction]) -> str:
173	    """
174	    Do several actions on the current page in one go, in this order: fill textboxes, choose options, tick boxes,
175	    or click buttons that keep you on this page (such as one per table row). Use refs from the latest view. It
176	    stops at the first action that fails or that leaves the page, and returns the new view. Put a button that
177	    moves to the next step only last, or click it on its own.
178	    """
179	    session = ctx.deps.session
180	    done: list[str] = []
181	    stop = ""
182	    hint = session.guard("fill_in", session.view) if session.guard is not None else None
183	    if hint:
184	        session.trace.event(session.name, "guard", action="fill_in", hint=hint[:160])
185	        return f"{hint}\n\n" + await session.look()
186	    async with session.lock:
187	        page, url, windows = session.page, session.page.url, len(session.pages)
188	        for step in actions:
189	            element = await locate(page, step.ref)
190	            if element is None:
191	                stop = f"no element {step.ref} (the page changed; use the new view)"
192	                break
193	            try:
194	                await _perform(element, step)
195	            except Exception as error:
196	                stop = f"{step.action} {step.ref} {step.value!r} failed: {str(error).splitlines()[0][:200]}"
197	                break
198	            done.append(f"{step.action} {step.ref}")
199	            await asyncio.sleep(0.15)
200	            if page.is_closed() or page.url != url or len(session.pages) != windows:
201	                if step is not actions[-1]:
202	                    stop = "the page changed after it; the remaining actions were not done"
203	                break
204	        await asyncio.sleep(0.25)
205	        await session.settle()
206	        session.trace.event(session.name, "action", action="fill_in", done=done, stop=stop,
207	                            asked=[step.model_dump() for step in actions])
208	        view = await session.look()
209	    report = f"Done: {', '.join(done) or 'nothing'}." + (f" Stopped: {stop}." if stop else "")
210	    return f"{report}\n\n{view}"
211	
212	
213	class PositionDesk:
214	    """
215	    The bid worker's tools for the positions: enter the calculated values of the position the model says is on
216	    screen, and total what was entered. Positions that fail are left for the model to omit.
217	    """
218	
219	    def __init__(self, entries: dict[str, dict], deadline: float):
220	        self.entries, self.deadline = entries, deadline
221	        self.plan = FillPlan()
222	        self.failures: dict[str, int] = {}
223	        self.entered: set[str] = set()
224	        self.choices: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {}
225	        self.synonyms: dict[tuple[str, str], str] = {}  # (control label, wanted value) -> the option the model named
226	        self.next_button = ""
227	        self.asked_unmapped = False
228	        self.nudged: set[str] = set()  # positions the worker was told once to enter before acting on their page
229	        self.after_positions = ""  # said once every position is entered: how to do the pages that follow
230	
231	    @property
232	    def tools(self) -> tuple:
233	        return (self.configure_position, self.net_total) if self.entries else ()
234	
235	    @property
236	    def known(self) -> set[str]:
237	        """The value names a control can be mapped to."""
238	        return set(VALUE_NAMES).union(*self.entries.values()) - {"position"}
239	
240	    def remember(self, fields: dict[str, str] | None, confirm_button: str = "", next_button: str = "") -> str:
241	        """
242	        Add to the control mapping and buttons. Unknown value names are dropped, the rest still counts; an error
243	        message only when that leaves no mapping at all, else ''.
244	        """
245	        if confirm_button:
246	            self.plan.confirm = confirm_button
247	        if next_button:
248	            self.next_button = next_button
249	        if fields:  # later calls add to or correct the mapping, they never drop what was mapped before
250	            known = self.known
251	            given = {label: name.strip() for label, name in fields.items()}
252	            unknown = sorted({name for name in given.values() if name not in known})
253	            given = {label: name for label, name in given.items() if name in known}
254	            self.plan.fields = {label: name for label, name in self.plan.fields.items() if name not in given.values()}
255	            self.plan.fields.update(given)
256	            if unknown and not self.plan.fields:
257	                return f"Unknown value names {unknown}; use only: {', '.join(sorted(known))}. Call again."
258	        return ""
259	
260	    async def map_position_form(self, ctx: RunContext[Deps], fields: dict[str, str], confirm_button: str = "",
261	                                next_button: str = "") -> str:
262	        """
263	        Tell, on a position page and without entering anything, which control takes which value, so the positions
264	        can be entered at once when the values are ready. `fields`: control label (exactly as in your view) ->
265	        value name. `confirm_button`: label of the button that applies a choice so the next choice opens.
266	        `next_button`: label of the button that saves the position and goes on (never one that omits or adds).
267	        """
268	        problems = mapping_problems(ctx.deps.session.view, fields or {}, self.known, (confirm_button, next_button))
269	        if problems:
270	            return "Not taken: " + "; ".join(problems) + ". Fix the mapping and call again."
271	        self.remember(fields, confirm_button, next_button)
272	        ctx.deps.session.trace.event(ctx.deps.session.name, "position_form_mapped", fields=self.plan.fields,
273	                                     confirm=self.plan.confirm, next=self.next_button)
274	        return "Mapping taken. Enter nothing on this page; return now."
275	
276	    async def configure_position(self, ctx: RunContext[Deps], position: str, fields: dict[str, str] | None = None,
277	                                 confirm_button: str = "", next_button: str = "",
278	                                 choices: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> str:
279	        """
280	        Enter all values of the position the form shows now and, once all are in, save it and go on with the form's
281	        next/continue button; then do the same for each following position of this bid the form shows, until a
282	        page needs you (a position to omit, a problem, or the step after the positions). `position`: the number
283	        of the position on the page now. `fields`: control label (exactly as in your view) -> value name; needed
284	        on the first call, later calls reuse it. `confirm_button`: label of the button that applies a choice so
285	        the next choice opens. `next_button`: label of the button that saves the position and goes on (never the
286	        one that omits or adds a position); needed once. `choices`: only when a call reported that no option
287	        equals an attribute: control label -> the option that means the same.
288	        """
289	        session, plan, asked = ctx.deps.session, self.plan, position.strip()
290	
291	        def refuse(reason: str, text: str) -> str:  # every early return is traced: the run logs show why
292	            session.trace.event(session.name, "configure_refused", position=asked, reason=reason,
293	                                fields=fields or {}, text=text[:300])
294	            return text
295	
296	        unknown = self.remember(fields, confirm_button, next_button)
297	        if unknown:
298	            return refuse("unknown_names", unknown)
299	        async with session.lock:
300	            view = await session.look()
301	            position, shown = resolve_position(asked, self.entries, view)
302	            if position is None or position not in shown:  # a page between two states: look again once settled
303	                await session.settle()
304	                view = await session.look()
305	                position, shown = resolve_position(asked, self.entries, view)
306	        if position is None:
307	            if shown:  # several of the bid's positions on one page: the model must name one of them
308	                return refuse("ambiguous", f"Name the position this page is about by its own number (one of "
309	                                           f"{', '.join(shown)}), then call again.")
310	            return refuse("no_values", f"No values for position {asked!r} (the page shows none of this bid's "
311	                                       f"positions {', '.join(sorted(self.entries, key=position_key))}): leave it "
312	                                       f"out with the form's option to omit a position. {self.so_far(session)}")
313	        if position not in shown:
314	            return refuse("not_on_page", f"Position {position} is not on the page now. Configure the position "
315	                                         "the page shows, by its own number; omit only a position that is not one "
316	                                         f"of {self.remaining()}.")
317	        entry = self.entries[position]
318	        if not plan.fields:
319	            return refuse("no_fields", f"Position {position} has values to enter. Give fields (control label -> "
320	                                       f"value name) for the controls of this form, then call again; do not omit it.")
321	        if self.failures.get(position, 0) >= 3:
322	            return refuse("failed", f"Position {position} failed three times: leave it out with the form's option "
323	                                    f"to omit a position. {self.so_far(session)}")
324	        if time.monotonic() > self.deadline - SIGNING_RESERVE:
325	            return refuse("time", "Time is short: leave this and every remaining position out and go on to "
326	                                  "signing. " + self.so_far(session))
327	        values, labels = unmapped(view, entry, plan.fields)
328	        if values and labels and not self.asked_unmapped:  # asked once per run; the next call fills as mapped
329	            self.asked_unmapped = True
330	            return refuse("unmapped", f"Nothing entered yet. This bid has values for {', '.join(values)}, but no "
331	                                      f"control is mapped to them, while these fields of the page are not mapped: "
332	                                      f"{'; '.join(labels)}. Call again now with fields that add every one of them "
333	                                      "that takes such a value (the mapping you gave stays); leave out fields that "
334	                                      "match none.")
335	        saved_now: list[str] = []  # the positions this call entered and saved before the one it ends on
336	        async with session.lock:
337	            while True:
338	                log: list[str] = []
339	                try:
340	                    error = await fill_position(session, entry, plan, log, self.picks(position, entry, choices))
341	                except Exception as exc:  # a slow or changed page: the model decides to retry or omit
342	                    error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {str(exc).splitlines()[0][:200]}"
343	                moved, saved = "", False
344	                if not error and self.next_button:  # the model named the button; clicking it is the mechanical part
345	                    view = await session.look()
346	                    ref, why = find_control(view, self.next_button, ("button",))
347	                    target = await locate(session.page, ref) if ref else None
348	                    if target is None:
349	                        moved = f" Could not save it: {why}; click the form's next/continue button yourself."
350	                    else:
351	                        await target.click(timeout=5000)
352	                        await session.settle()
353	                        moved, saved = f" Saved with {self.next_button!r}; the page below is the form's next step.", True
354	                session.trace.event(session.name, "configure_position", position=position, done=log, error=error,
355	                                    moved=moved, after=len(saved_now))
356	                view = await session.look()
357	                if error:
358	                    break
359	                self.entered.add(position)
360	                following = self.following(view) if saved and POSITION_BATCH else None
361	                if following is None or time.monotonic() > self.deadline - SIGNING_RESERVE:
362	                    break
363	                saved_now.append(f"{position} ({'; '.join(log)})")  # the form went on to another of this bid's
364	                position, entry, choices, asked = following, self.entries[following], None, following
365	        before = f"Entered and saved: {'; then '.join(saved_now)}. " if saved_now else ""
366	        if error:
367	            self.failures[position] = self.failures.get(position, 0) + 1
368	            self.entered.discard(position)
369	            return (f"{before}Position {position} not fully entered: {error}. Entered so far: "
370	                    f"{'; '.join(log) or 'nothing'}. Fix the mapping and call again, or leave the position out with "
371	                    f"the form's option to omit it. {self.so_far(session)}\n\n{view}")
372	        then = moved or " Check it, then save and continue with the form's next/continue button."
373	        which = "" if position == asked else f" (the page showed {position}, not {asked!r}; {position} was entered)"
374	        done = self.after_positions if set(self.entries) <= self.entered else ""
375	        return (f"{before}Position {position} entered{which}: {'; '.join(log)}.{then} {self.so_far(session)} Still "
376	                f"to enter when the form shows them: {self.remaining()}.{done}\n\n{view}")

378	    def pending_on(self, view: str) -> str | None:
379	        """The one position of this bid the page shows, if it is still to enter (not entered, not failed)."""
380	        position, shown = resolve_position("", self.entries, view)
381	        if position is None or shown != [position] or position in self.entered or self.failures.get(position):
382	            return None
383	        return position

385	    def following(self, view: str) -> str | None:
386	        """
387	        After a save: the position to go on with, when the form now shows the input page of another position of
388	        this bid, as mapped (the save button and a mapped control are on it). A page that merely names a position
389	        is left to the model.
390	        """
391	        position = self.pending_on(view)
392	        if position is None or find_control(view, self.next_button, ("button",))[0] is None:
393	            return None
394	        mapped = any(find_control(view, label, ("select", "textbox", "textarea"))[0] for label in self.plan.fields)
395	        return position if mapped else None

397	    def premature(self, view: str) -> str | None:
398	        """
399	        Before the worker clicks or types on a page itself: when the page shows exactly one position this bid has
400	        values for, which is neither entered nor tried yet, say once to enter it first. (One sandbox run clicked
401	        past a position's page and so left it out.) Said once per position, so a page that merely mentions the
402	        number can never hold the worker up.
403	        """
404	        position = self.pending_on(view)
405	        if position is None or position in self.nudged:
406	            return None
407	        self.nudged.add(position)
408	        return (f"This page shows position {position}, which this bid enters: call configure_position("
409	                f"'{position}', ...) now; it enters all its values and saves it. Do not omit it and do not move "
410	                "on without it. (If this is not that position's own input page, repeat your action.)")
411	
412	    def remaining(self) -> str:
413	        """The bid's positions not entered yet: the form may show them in any order; none of them is omitted."""
414	        left = sorted(set(self.entries) - self.entered, key=position_key)
415	        return ", ".join(left) or "none"

417	    def picks(self, position: str, entry: dict, choices: dict[str, str] | None) -> dict[str, str]:
418	        """
419	        The model's option picks for this position's worded choices: what it named for this position (a revisit
420	        needs the same), and what it named for the same control and the same value on an earlier position (a
421	        "none" attribute that the form words differently comes up again and needs no second failed attempt).
422	        """
423	        remembered = self.choices.setdefault(position, {})
424	        remembered.update(choices or {})
425	        for label, option in (choices or {}).items():
426	            key = next((k for l, k in self.plan.fields.items() if clean(l) == clean(label)), None)
427	            if key is not None and entry.get(key) is not None:
428	                self.synonyms[(clean(label), clean(str(entry[key])))] = option
429	        picks = {label: self.synonyms[(clean(label), clean(str(entry[key])))]
430	                 for label, key in self.plan.fields.items()
431	                 if entry.get(key) is not None and (clean(label), clean(str(entry[key]))) in self.synonyms}
432	        picks.update(remembered)
433	        return picks

435	    def so_far(self, session: SiteSession) -> str:
436	        """The running net total, told after every position so the totals step needs no arithmetic."""
437	        total = german(self.total())
438	        session.seen += "\n" + total  # our own figure: let the worker's result mention it
439	        entered = ", ".join(sorted(self.entered, key=position_key)) or "none"
440	        return f"Net total of the positions entered so far: {total} ({entered}); enter the latest such figure."

442	    def entry_total(self, position: str) -> Decimal:
443	        entry = self.entries[position]
444	        return Decimal(str(entry["quantity"])) * Decimal(str(entry["unit_price"]))

446	    def total(self, omitted: set[str] = frozenset()) -> Decimal:
447	        return sum((self.entry_total(p) for p in self.entered - omitted), Decimal(0))

449	    def expected(self) -> str:
450	        """What the review should show for each position entered, for the summary check and the signing pass."""
451	        lines = []
452	        for p in sorted(self.entered, key=position_key):
453	            e = self.entries[p]
454	            extra = ", ".join(f"{label} {german(e[key])}" for key, label in (
455	                ("base_unit_price", "base price"), ("surcharge_per_unit", "surcharge per piece"),
456	                ("packaging_per_unit", "packaging per piece"), ("rebate_total", "bonus for the position"))
457	                if e.get(key) is not None)
458	            lines.append(f"  - position {p}: material {e['material_number']}, quantity {e['quantity']}, net unit "
459	                         f"price {german(e['unit_price'])}, lead time {e['lead_time_weeks']} weeks"
460	                         + (f", {extra}" if extra else ""))

463	    async def net_total(self, omitted: list[str] | None = None) -> str:
464	        """
465	        The bid's net total in German format: quantity x unit price summed over the positions entered with
466	        configure_position(), minus any listed in `omitted` (positions you left out after all).
467	        """
468	        dropped = {p.strip() for p in omitted or []}
469	        return f"{german(self.total(dropped))} (positions {', '.join(sorted(self.entered - dropped)) or 'none'})"

472	def _positions(answer: dict | None, desk: PositionDesk, filled: bool, prepared: bool = False) -> str:
473	    """
474	    The decision and position part of the requirements: before the form phase, how to enter them; after it, what
475	    the review must show (the positions actually entered, all others omitted, the total of the entered ones).
476	    """
477	    discount = german((answer or {}).get("discount_percent") or 0)
478	    if answer and answer.get("decision") == "no_bid":
479	        back = (" If the form shows a position step (an earlier pass chose the main offer before the decision was "
480	                "known), go back with the form's back button to the offer-type step and choose the declaration "
481	                "there: going back only clears steps that hold nothing yet;" if prepared and not filled else "")
482	        return ("- decision: no bid: choose the form's declaration that you do not submit an offer (not a main or "
483	                f"alternative offer); no positions;{back}\n- discount {discount} and net total 0,00;")
484	    head = "- decision: bid (main offer, not an alternative offer);\n"
485	    if filled and desk.entered:
486	        return head + (f"- exactly {len(desk.entered)} position(s) entered, each with these values:\n"
487	                       f"{desk.expected()}\n"
488	                       "- every other position omitted, and no added or extra position;\n"
489	                       f"- discount {discount} and net total {german(desk.total())} (German number format; never a "
490	                       "gross amount);")
491	    if not desk.entries:
492	        return head + ("- leave every position out with the form's option to omit a position (where the form shows "
493	                       "one position per step, omit each in turn); do not configure materials, prices or lead times, "
494	                       f"and never use options that add positions;\n- discount {discount} and net total 0,00 (German "
495	                       "number format);")
496	    names = sorted({key for entry in desk.entries.values() for key in entry} - {"position"})
497	    if desk.plan.fields and desk.next_button:
498	        mapping = ("- configure_position() already knows which control takes which value and the buttons to apply a "
499	                   "choice and to save (an earlier pass mapped them on a position page): call it with the position "
500	                   "number alone; add fields only if it reports a control it cannot find;\n")
501	    else:
502	        mapping = f"- configure_position() needs, once, {mapping_guide(names)}\n"
503	    return head + f"""- enter exactly these positions: {', '.join(sorted(desk.entries))}. The form shows one position
504	  at a time, in its own order (often not this list's order). On every position page, first call
505	  configure_position() with the number the page shows: it enters all values of a position of this bid, saves it
506	  with the next/continue button you name and goes on by itself with the following positions of this list that
507	  the form shows; when it returns, the view below its answer is the page that needs you (or it tells you to
508	  omit a position). Never omit a position of this list unless
509	  configure_position() told you to omit that very position. Never pick options or type position values yourself;
510	{mapping}- leave out, with the form's option to omit a position, every other position and any position where
511	  configure_position() reports a problem it cannot resolve. Never use options that add positions; if the form
512	  shows an extra position you did not ask for, remove it or leave it out;
513	- discount {discount}; net total: the latest figure configure_position() reports for the positions entered so
514	  far (net_total() repeats it; pass positions you entered but left out after all). Enter both exactly as given
515	  (German number format), never a sum you work out yourself, a gross amount or a sum the page proposes;"""
516

518	def mapping_guide(names) -> str:
519	    """How to map a position page's controls to value names (configure_position and map_position_form)."""
520	    return f"""which control takes which value: map each control's label (as your view shows
521	  it) to one of these value names: {', '.join(names)}. Choices that open further choices (attributes of the
522	  material) map to the attribute with the same meaning; the material/catalogue number control to material_number;
523	  unit price, base price, surcharge, packaging and the bonus or rebate for the whole position to unit_price,
524	  base_unit_price, surcharge_per_unit, packaging_per_unit and rebate_total; lead time to lead_time_weeks. Leave out
525	  controls with no matching value. Also name the button that applies a choice so the next one opens, and the
526	  button that saves the position and goes on to the next step (not the ones that omit or add a position);"""

715	class BidFlow:
716	    """
717	    The bid form overlapped with the research. Right after the briefing, a worker (the model) does the form's steps
718	    that need no calculated value (bidder data with the contact address, expression of interest, the main offer as
719	    offer type) and maps the controls of the first position page, then stops there. While the research runs, a
720	    cheap background request keeps the portal session (and with it the unsaved wizard state) alive; when the
721	    session is lost anyway, the page is reloaded and the steps are done again. finish() then enters the answer from
722	    the position step on, checks and signs (submit_bid). If the research ends in no_bid, the form worker goes back
723	    to the offer type, which clears only empty steps. AGENT_FORM_OVERLAP=0 turns this off.
724	    """
725	
726	    def __init__(self, session: SiteSession, mailbox: Mailbox, briefing: Briefing, deadline: float):
727	        self.session, self.mailbox, self.briefing, self.deadline = session, mailbox, briefing, deadline
728	        self.desk = PositionDesk({}, deadline)
729	        self.address: asyncio.Task | None = None
730	        self.task: asyncio.Task | None = None
731	        self.ready = False  # a pass stopped at the positions and the session has not been lost since
732	        self.preparing = False
733	        self.passes = 0
734	
735	    def start(self) -> None:
736	        self.address = asyncio.create_task(self.mailbox.address())
737	        if os.environ.get("AGENT_FORM_OVERLAP", "1") != "0":
738	            self.task = asyncio.create_task(self._run())
739	
740	    def contact_address(self) -> asyncio.Task:
741	        """The address lookup; started again when the first one found nothing (e.g. the webmail was still down)."""
742	        if self.address is None or (self.address.done() and (self.address.cancelled() or not self.address.result())):
743	            self.address = asyncio.create_task(self.mailbox.address())
