AUDIT: bid entry, signing and browser layer (read-only, nothing edited or run)

All paths are under /Users/gaurav/Downloads/ehl_final/error404ai_ehl_finals/agent/. I read submit.py, configurator.py, browser_tools.py, worker.py, llm.py, extract.py and agent.py in full, and skimmed clef.py. I grepped orchestrator.py, research.py, briefing.py and run.py only for time constants and callers; they are not audited. I checked two library behaviours in the installed venv: pydantic-ai lets non-ModelRetry tool exceptions escape the run (and ModelAPIError is not an UnexpectedModelBehavior), and Playwright refuses non-numeric text in input[type=number].

FINDINGS (most severe first)

1. browser_tools.py:66-84 — `const CLOSE = /^(×|✕|✖|x|schließen|schliessen|close|dismiss|...)$/i` ... `b.click(); if (d.tagName === 'DIALOG' && d.open) d.close();`
   - Class: OVERFIT + ELIGIBILITY RISK. Severity: high.
   - Every modal (`dialog[open]`, `[role=dialog][aria-modal=true]`, `[role=alertdialog]`) with a close button is closed by a MutationObserver before the model sees it; there is no opt-out.
   - Breaks when: the private portal puts the TAN entry, the "submit bindingly?" confirmation, a position editor, a material search or a document viewer in a modal with an × button.
   - act() then replies "Nothing on the page changed after click ... Do not repeat it" (browser_tools.py:736-738), which steers the model away from the retry that would work (`d.dataset.arClosed` only spares a reused element).

2. extract.py:60-68 — `if (tag === 'A' && el.hasAttribute('href')) return true; ... return !!(role && ROLES.has(role)) || el.hasAttribute('onclick');` and extract.py:120-121 `for (const child of node.childNodes)`
   - Class: OVERFIT. Severity: high (can block the whole run).
   - Only native controls, ARIA roles and inline `onclick` get a ref. The walk never enters shadow roots. There is no click-by-text or coordinate fallback.
   - Breaks when: the site is built with React/Vue/Angular or web components: clickable `<tr>` mail rows, `<a>` without href, `<div class="btn">` "next" buttons, `<label>` over a `display:none` checkbox (the input is dropped at 35-39). The model sees text it cannot act on.
   - Same file, 35-39: decoys hidden by `opacity:0`, off-screen position or zero size are not filtered and reach the model as page text.

3. submit.py:351 — `await target.click(timeout=5000)`; submit.py:628-633 `try: ready, _ = await run_worker(...) finally: bid_session.guard = None`; worker.py:172 `except (asyncio.TimeoutError, UsageLimitExceeded, UnexpectedModelBehavior, Stuck)`
   - Class: ELIGIBILITY RISK. Severity: high.
   - The save click in configure_position is outside the try at 339-342 and has no JS-click fallback (unlike browser_tools._click). A Playwright error or a ModelAPIError (llm.py:224) escapes run_worker and skips the signing pass of that submit_bid call.
   - agent.py:92-96 retries once with a fresh PositionDesk (entered set and mapping lost, form mid-way). A second escape leaves solve() with nothing signed.
   - Breaks when: a sticky footer, toast or banner covers the form's save button for 5 s.
   - Also agent.py:126-127: `path.write_text(...)` sits unguarded between research and signing.

4. agent.py:32 `SAFETY_SECONDS = 90`; submit.py:31-32 `SIGNING_RESERVE = 180 ... (seen: 25-30 s, 173 s)`, `LAST_CHANCE = 45`; submit.py:630 `max_steps=45 + 3 * len(desk.entries)`; submit.py:324-326 "Time is short: leave this and every remaining position out"
   - Class: ELIGIBILITY RISK (reserves do not add up). Severity: high.
   - The 90 s tail is reserved for an API POST that a site submission never makes. A signing pass that times out at `deadline` exits with 90 s unused, and the last-chance test at 676 is then false.
   - The 180 s reserve was already observed 173 s full. 45 s for the last chance is less than a slow TAN round trip.
   - By grep, research may run to deadline − 390 (orchestrator.py:51), leaving about 210 s for all positions, less ADDRESS_WAIT 15 and FINISH_WAIT 45.
   - If the form pass times out, the second pass (30 steps) must omit every remaining position one model step at a time and do the TAN round trip inside 180 s; configure_position refuses by then.
   - Step caps scale with positions to enter, not positions to omit.
   - Breaks when: the tender has 25 positions, one per page, and the answer is empty or late. 45 + 30 + 15 requests do not reach the signature.

5. configurator.py:111-113 `if exact: return exact[0][0], ""`; configurator.py:254-256 `"no control mapped for ...: add them to fields"`; submit.py:503-509 "The form shows one position at a time ... Never pick options or type position values yourself"
   - Class: OVERFIT. Severity: high (most of the 75 position points).
   - The mechanical filler assumes one position per page, with material, quantity, price and lead time all as labelled native select/textbox/textarea on that page. The model is forbidden to enter values itself, so there is no escape hatch.
   - Breaks when:
     - all positions are rows of one table with repeated labels: every position's values are written to row 1 and each is reported "entered";
     - quantity is prefilled or read-only text: it can never be mapped, so every position is omitted;
     - material is chosen by radio list, custom combobox, autocomplete or modal picker;
     - inputs have no `<label>`/aria-label/name (table-layout forms): `find_control` cannot address them;
     - price or lead time sit on a later step.
   - Chained-select specifics, configurator.py:300-310: without a confirm button there is no settle after `select_option`, so the next level is read from a stale view. "lost its choice after ..." fails a position when the site replaces the select with text.

6. configurator.py:52-64 `return f"{number:.{places}f}".replace(".", ",")`; configurator.py:312-314 `if await element.evaluate("e => e.value") != value: return f"{label!r} did not take {value!r}"`; submit.py:489, 494, 515 "(German number format)"
   - Class: OVERFIT. Severity: high (score).
   - Breaks when: the price field is `<input type="number">` (Playwright raises on "1234,50"), expects a decimal point, or reformats on input ("1.234,50 €"). The strict string read-back fails, three failures tell the model to omit the position, and the result is a signed bid without positions.
   - Discount and total are also forced to comma format by prompt and by net_total().

7. configurator.py:151-154 `first = re.search(r"\[e\d+ (select|textarea|checkbox|radio) ", view)` ... `(?<![\w.])...(?![\w]|\.\d)`; submit.py:310-316
   - Class: OVERFIT + UNDERFIT. Severity: high (score; time-threatening).
   - Code, not the model, decides which position is on screen, by matching the answer's position string in the text above the first non-textbox control.
   - Breaks when:
     - the page writes "Pos. 4" for "01.04", or the number is in a select or below a checkbox: the "no_values" refusal tells the model to omit a position it has values for;
     - "not_on_page" and "ambiguous" refusals never increment `failures`, so the three-strikes exit cannot fire and the worker loops to its deadline;
     - position ids are plain integers: they collide with "Schritt 3 von 7", so a wrongly named position passes `named[0] in shown` and its values go into another position's page;
     - the page is all textboxes: the "head" is the whole view, so batching and the premature guard go quiet.

Request a new TAN with this tool again."; submit.py:44-47 SigningTan; submit.py:135-139 "(the highest request number; new TAN messages are listed without a search, newest first ...)"; submit.py:589-590 "valid for five minutes"

   - A fetched TAN is not handed to the last-chance pass, which must request again.
